description: The main, compose, event editor, settings and reminder windows. App commands (maild_*, open_link, open_part, save_content, in_flatpak, portal_save_file, notify_mail, open_compose, open_event, open_settings, open_reminders, app_config_*, server_facts) are allowed by default; the window permissions back the app's own title bars, and the dialog picks files to attach and confirms. The file chooser portal picks where Save As writes in the Flatpak, so dialog:allow-save is for every other install.
